ns2:course.label: Introduction to Journalism
ns2:course.description: Discussion of the history, freedom, technologies, ethics, and functions of the news media. Training in clear, descriptive writing techniques, using journalistic models. Prerequisite: Completion of Composition I general education requirement.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Completion of Composition I general education requirement.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students may not enroll in JOUR 200 and JOUR 400 in the same semester. Students must register for one discussion and one lecture section.
